thread:
elaine: :rotating_light: paging: steady spike in 5xxs and mis-routed model variants causing high latency for eu-west customers — traffic started routing to tiny-quantized-v2 (incompatible) around 03:02 UTC, then regional fallback kicked in and created a request loop. seeing lots of model-compat errors in the logs. paging oncall

mike (oncall): on it. grabbing logs now. can you paste the alert id?

elaine: alert id: infra-alert-9821. sample error: `ModelCompatibilityError: kv-cache-size-mismatch` and `inference-timeout` on downstream proxies. stack shows initial routing decision to model tiny-quantized-v2 in eu-west then immediate fallback to us-east then back to eu-west. looks like policy decided to prefer region fallback repeatedly.

incident-bot: [AUTO] Incident created: INC-2026-215 — Smart routing anomaly (policy mismatch). Paginated to oncall.

mike (oncall): thanks. quick summary to the pager: 03:02 UTC routing policy started picking incompatible model variant for eu-west causing 5xxs and increased p95 latency ~8-18s for affected routes. early mitigation: will pin traffic to stable model variants in the region and disable automatic region fallback.

sanaz: @mike (oncall) paging in — i'm taking over in 10m for handoff. what's current impact estimate?

elaine: initial sweep: ~12 customers with active sessions in eu-west, 4 of them showing >50% error rates on generative endpoints, a handful of embedded clients with noisy retries. top customer reported timeouts in their UI.

mike (oncall): running quick command to list active routing policies and recent schema changes:
```
redwoodctl routing policies list --region eu-west --changed-since "2026-03-15T02:45:00Z"
```

mike (oncall): output shows a config migration at 02:58 UTC where `prefer_secondary` (deprecated) was removed and a new `fallback_behavior` field was introduced. The migration script mapped missing values to the new field by defaulting to `prefer_secondary=true` earlier, but schema change altered the default to `allow_fallback=true` with ambiguous semantics. looks like some policies ended up with `fallback_behavior: loop` (buggy enum mapping).

ryan: (from infra) that enum mapping was part of last night's quick schema deploy — i suspected there were edge cases but no flagged rollouts. i can push a targeted fix to map deprecated flags explicitly. recommend immediate rollback of the schema migration for routing-policy-service.

sanaz: mitigation plan: 1) pin eu-west routes to `stable-v1` model variant; 2) disable cross-region fallback at routing proxy level; 3) rollback schema mapping to previous safe behavior. i'll coordinate handoff with cs for customer comms.

tariq: (deploy ops) prepping a hotfix. to pin model variant run:
```
redwoodctl route update --route-id <route> --model-variant stable-v1 --no-fallback
```
I'll stage to eu-west now and confirm.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: hotfix/pin-stable-variant -> routing-proxy-eu-west (sha: deadbeef). Estimated 30s to rollout.

mike (oncall): rolling pin now to affected routes. also appending a temporary policy that denies `fallback_behavior: loop` values:
```
# temp policy
if routing_policy.fallback_behavior == "loop":
  override.fallback_behavior = "off"
```
Applying at 03:12 UTC.

elaine: seeing immediate drop in 5xxs after pin — errors down ~80% on first checks. latency p95 improving to ~2.3s. customers still need verification from CS.

cs-lead: CS note: we reached out to 3 impacted customers (account owners) and they're confirming degraded experience between 03:02–03:14 UTC; one requested postmortem. tagging them for follow-up.

ryan: rollbacks in progress. i'll open a PR to ensure migration script explicitly sets `fallback_behavior: "off"` when deprecated flags are present, and to add a unit test for enum mapping.

sanaz: handoff: mike — leaving oncall. taking command at 03:20 UTC. mike: please annotate what you did in the incident timeline.

mike (oncall): done. notes: pinned routes, disabled cross-region fallback, applied temporary override to block loop enum. left follow-up tasks for infra: PR to migration script, add integration test, and run a canary of schema change in staging with traffic generator.

incident-bot: [AUTO] Incident updated: Mitigation applied — partial service restoration. Severity lowered to S2.

tariq: rollout complete on eu-west proxies. monitoring for oscillation.

elaine: logs snippet from 03:10 UTC showing error signatures if helpful
```
[03:10:12] routing-policy-evaluator: selected_variant=tiny-quantized-v2 (deprecated)
[03:10:12] model-gateway-eu-west: ModelCompatibilityError: kv-cache-size-mismatch; expected 2048 got 512
[03:10:13] routing-proxy: fallback to us-east triggered
[03:10:13] routing-policy-evaluator: selected_variant=stable-v1
[03:10:14] routing-proxy: route back to eu-west (loop detetected)
```

sanaz: next steps assigned: ryan to PR migration script + tests; infra to add gating for schema deploys; ops to add a safety check in routing-proxy that prevents immediate cross-region bounce for the same request id. cs to prepare customer-facing timeline. i'll own postmortem + RCA and include mitigation timeline.

mike (oncall): leaving a final note — root cause: schema migration changed default mapping for deprecated field and introduced an invalid enum mapping (`loop`) that allowed the policy evaluator to re-trigger fallback continuously. fix path: map deprecated flags explicitly, tighten migration tests, add runtime guard for fallback loops.

cs-lead: thanks all. i'll consolidate impacted account list and prepare comms draft.

incident-bot: [AUTO] Incident resolved: Partial restore at 03:18 UTC. Monitoring continues.

sanaz: closing handoff — will run RCA writeup and share in #postmortems by EOD. :wave:
